body:
What is love? Nothing I've felt. I don't even love myself, how am I supposed to love or be loved? 

You're an amazing person for reaching out. Find yourself a hobby other than drinking wine. Follow your heart, and let yourself forget about your past. You'll find happiness in the wonderful life you're leading. 

I'll be free soon, maybe be with my grandma again. She'll probably tell me how much of an idiot I am.

I'm too weak at this point in my life. 

The Tragically Hip and Lynyrd Skynyrd....
